notes: Fuel evaporation and spillage rates (rules/logistics/10-fuel.md). Printed only in the rules text of 49.3, not as a separate chart; per the plan, the source .adoc transcription is the second reading. Scan (jp2 66) and .adoc agree: 0 of 3 rates differ

Whether the 9% Commonwealth rate stands in for the 6% or is added to it, and whether the hot-weather 5% is added on top, is R-042; the 'replaces' field records the reading the prose uses pending that ruling
Whether fuel in vehicles' own tanks (fuel capacity) evaporates is R-040; the Land Game hot-weather rule (29.3x) excludes it, 49.3 says 'regardless of where it is kept'
Fuel in convoys at sea is exempt from the stores-expenditure-stage rate; 49.3 is silent on sea convoys for the hot-weather rate
The Commonwealth period runs from September 1940 through the last game-turn of August 1941, inclusive

rows.applies_to: both sides, all fuel on the map (not in convoys at sea)
both sides, each operations stage with hot weather, in addition
